data: Does the red line on the left plot consistently have higher F1 scores than the orange line?

The red line represents the GP-ICM method, while the orange line represents the NB method. The caption indicates that the test set is fixed to all but the first 50 tweets of the target rumour used for training in the LPO setting on the PHEME dataset. 

Looking at the Micro-F1 scores, the red line (GP-ICM) consistently has higher values than the orange line (NB) across all training sizes. This can be observed in both the left and right plots. Therefore, the red line on the left plot consistently has higher F1 scores than the orange line.
